content.title: Narcos (2015) | MUBI
content.text: soy el fuego que arde tu piel soy el agua que mata tu sed el castillo, la torre yo soy la espada que guarda el caudal tu el aire que respiro yo y la luz de la luna en el mar la garganta que ancio mojar que temo ahogar de amor y cuales deseos me vas a dar - mi tesoro basta con mirarlo tuyo será, y tuyo será[Netflix] Should have ended with Escobar's demise. Season 3 needed more Murphy vs/with Peña . Notwithstanding Chepe, Navegante and Salcedo, Pallomari and David. Peña is too by himself."Plata o Plomo" | "I am not a rich man, I am a poor man who has money" ==Je ne suis pas un riche, je suis un pauvre qui a de l'argent (Pablo ESCOBAR). Starring excellent Wagner MOURA (Pablo ESCOBAR), Boyd HOLBROOK & Luis GUZMAN as guest. Paulina GAITAN, as ESCOBAR's wife, is magnifica & Stephanie SIGMAN, as ESCOBAR's mistress, is stunning. 20 first episodes following Escobar's life & death are a great thrill !I've been in Colombia 2 or 3 times in the 90's and I admire the accuracy of this series. Furthermore, the production found actors who really but really look like the real protagonists. Don’t miss ‘Escobar: El Patrón del Mal’ for the Colombian point of view. Masterpiece.A bunch of amazing actors, good storytelling, packed with action, nice direction and cinematography along with a stellar soundtrack. What's not to love? Moura's accent is shit (aren't accent coaches a thing?). But the show is not any less amazing because of it! Also, I might have developed a crush on Pedro Pascal. Peña is <3.Gran serie! Narrada desde la perspectiva de los agentes de la DEA con voz en off, desarrollan muy bien la historia tanto del Cártel de Medellín como el de Cali. Sin duda, lo mejor y más memorable es la historia de Pablo Escobar, cómo crean una atmósfera de investigación para dar con los hechos precisos que se documentaron en esa época. También, me gusta cómo cuentan el declive y captura de Escobar, quedándose cada vez más solo. Luego, la historia del Cártel de Cali también me gustó, pero básicamente por la performance del agente Peña de la DEA, y cómo llega a capturar a los capos del Cártel.The idea of idolizing Pablo Escobar is a little bit off but I can understand why they did it. Anyway the tv series is very well made, great actors, brazilians speaking spanish and a portuguese (my proud) that did a badass job (actor: Pedro Fernandes aka Pêpê Rapazote). Exciting and addictive, like some of the subjects in the series.Series 1 was one of the most promising series of 2015, but I loved series 2! Series 3 definitely the least interesting the series and while without Escobar in this one, the real loss was agent Murphy - not sure if the replacements lived up to the older characters. Series 3 = 3 stars.
